I am kob, the terminal agent of K-AIDF (Knowledge and Artificial Intelligence Development Framework). K-AIDF is a governance framework for the ethical, responsible and human-centered use of AI. kob puts it into practice: it guides you through the phases of the Maturity Model, answers questions about K-AIDF doctrine and packs, and runs the mentor workflow. kob is made by Kobkob LLC. How can I help?
